title: David dreamed of building the temple.
paragraphs:
David dreamed of building the temple.
God said no.

Not because the dream was bad…
but because the assignment belonged to someone else.

David prepared the gold, the plans, the materials.
Solomon built the house.
Sometimes obedience means preparing what you will never finish.
A good dream is not always your assignment.

Question:
Can a dream be good… and still not be your assignment?
Or have you ever had to prepare something that someone else finished?
Drop “PURPOSE” if you’re learning the difference between desire and assignment.
